repo_notes.content: Do not mention roblox at all, so roblox doesnt sue me, Also documentate Kilang Supersets

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the Kinemium Engine, its purpose as a sandbox game engine built on Luau/Zune, its Roblox-like API, and high-level architecture overview

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Guide users through installing, configuring, and running their first Kinemium Engine project

pages.title: Installation and Setup
pages.purpose: Explain how to install the Kinemium Engine using the updater script, install the Zune runtime, and configure the development environment

pages.title: Command Line Options
pages.purpose: Document the various command-line flags (--client, --server, --headless, --kilang) and their effects on engine execution

pages.title: Your First Script
pages.purpose: Walk through creating a simple script in the sandboxed folder, understanding the game environment, and basic object manipulation

pages.title: Core Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the fundamental architectural patterns of the engine: service system, instance model, and module organization

pages.title: DataModel and Service System
pages.purpose: Document the DataModel as service locator, how services are initialized, and the relationship between game object and services

pages.title: Instance System and Class Registry
pages.purpose: Explain the Instance base class, the Registry system for dynamic class loading, property system, and signals

pages.title: Module System and Aliases
pages.purpose: Document the .luaurc module alias system, how to import modules, and the require/import/include patterns

pages.title: Rendering System
pages.purpose: Overview of the rendering architecture, signal-based pipeline, and integration with Raylib

pages.title: Renderer Core and Main Loop
pages.purpose: Detail the renderer initialization, main step loop, signal system, and frame lifecycle events

pages.title: 3D Rendering Pipeline
pages.purpose: Explain the 3D rendering stack, Workspace integration, mesh rendering, camera system, and mouse raycasting

pages.title: 2D and GUI Rendering
pages.purpose: Document the 2D rendering stack, GUI registry system, and how GUI objects are rendered each frame

pages.title: Post-Processing and Shaders
pages.purpose: Explain the blur system, shader loading, and custom rendering effects

pages.title: Lighting System
pages.purpose: Document the Lighting service, Kilights integration, volumetric clouds, SSAO, and skybox rendering

pages.title: Raylib FFI Bindings
pages.purpose: Reference for the Raylib FFI function bindings, data structures, and how to use them

pages.title: Physics System
pages.purpose: Overview of the dual physics engine architecture (Jolt for 3D, Box2D for 2D) and KinemiumPhysicsService

pages.title: KinemiumPhysicsService
pages.purpose: Document the unified physics service API, how it abstracts Jolt and Box2D, and integration with Parts

pages.title: Jolt Physics Integration
pages.purpose: Explain Jolt 3D physics engine integration, initialization workflow, and world management

pages.title: Box2D Physics Integration
pages.purpose: Document Box2D 2D physics engine, its use in ScreenGuis, and FFI bindings

pages.title: Physics Bodies and Shapes
pages.purpose: Detail body creation, shape types, mass properties, and collision filtering for both engines

pages.title: Constraints and Joints
pages.purpose: Document the various constraint types (distance, hinge, slider, etc.) and motor systems

pages.title: User Interface
pages.purpose: Overview of the UI system, Aereon framework, and editor components

pages.title: Aereon UI Framework
pages.purpose: Document the Aereon windowing system, window creation, theming, and step loop integration

pages.title: GUI Components
pages.purpose: Reference for GuiObject, Frame, TextLabel, TextButton, ImageLabel and their properties

pages.title: Layout and Positioning
pages.purpose: Explain UDim2, position calculation, anchor points, and the recursive rendering system

pages.title: Input and Events
pages.purpose: Document the signal system for GUI events, mouse interactions, and input handling

pages.title: Editor Tools
pages.purpose: Document the built-in editor UI: Explorer, Toolbar, Output console, Properties panel, and Viewport

pages.title: UI Modifiers and Effects
pages.purpose: Document UIStroke, UICorner, UIGradient, BlurEffect and other visual modifier components

pages.title: Scripting and Environment
pages.purpose: Overview of the Kilang scripting system, sandboxing, and script execution lifecycle
